description: List the newest webhook delivery attempts across every endpoint of the workspace, newest first, each with its endpoint, event, URL, status (pending, success or failed), attempts, responseCode, error and the next retry time. Read-only; the way to see why a site did not react to a publish or an order. To send a failed one again, redeliver_webhook_delivery; the endpoints themselves, list_webhooks.

limit.description: How many of the newest attempts to return, 1-100

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List webhook deliveries
